prompt:
Write a first-person account (about 120 words) by the driver for an insurance claim form. Accident: rear-end collision in Conroe, Texas. Injury: neck and back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1170; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The claimant told the same account in every conversation.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: I was stopped at a red light on a main road in Conroe, Texas, when the car behind me struck the back of my vehicle. The impact was firm enough to jolt me forward and back against the seat. I got out briefly to check on the other driver, and we exchanged insurance details at the scene. Since then I have described what happened the same way to everyone I have spoken with, including the adjuster, the medical staff, and the people at my body shop. I am the named driver on the policy listed on this form. Afterward I felt stiffness and soreness in my neck and lower back, which has made turning my head and sitting for long periods uncomfortable. I have been seeing a physical therapist and following the treatment plan I was given. I am providing this account so the details of the collision are recorded accurately.
